newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel real wages stable - statistics bureau.
newsitem.headline: Israel real wages stable - statistics bureau.

text.p: In the second quarter of 1996 average salaries in Israel in real terms remained unchanged compared with salaries in the same period last year, the Central Bureau of Statistics said on Monday.
The average salary in Israel in the second quarter of the year was 5,150 shekels.
The figures do not include Palestinian workers but include legal foreign workers, the bureau said.
Average salaries in the second quarter of the year rose 0.6 percent in real terms compared with the first quarter of the year.
The figures show that workers who work in the field of electricity and water were the highest paid, while those who work in food services were paid the lowest.

In the first half of the year real wages in the public sector rose 4.4 percent compared with the same period last year. This compares with an increase of 0.8 percent in real wages in the overall economy, the bureau said.
